name: Cerrado Protected Areas: Chapada dos Veadeiros and Emas National Parks
description: Two national parks in central Brazil protect the Cerrado, a vast tropical savanna that is among the oldest and most diverse ecosystems on Earth. Chapada dos Veadeiros and Emas preserve its characteristic plants, animals and habitats. For thousands of years they have served as refuges for species during climate shifts, and they remain vital to the region's future biodiversity.
